title: Abishag
summary: Raleigh names Abishag in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Abishag, the young maid which lay in Dauids bosome in his latter dayes, to keepe him warme. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVIII, §. I, sig. 302b–303a
